messages:
alex_k: FYI seeing a burst of 401/503s from EU customers starting ~09:12 UTC. Also billing alerted for unexpected cross-region egress spike :eyes:

alex_k: sample log: `req_id=01A23Z upstream_region=us-east-1 desired_region=eu-west-1 error=401 auth=failed header_x_region_hint=eu-west-1`

support_eli: on it — we got a high-priority alert from the customer about slow API + auth failures. Customer says requests from EU are being routed to us-east and hitting different auth realm.

oncall_bot: ALERT: 3xx->5xx error rate increase on /v1/generate (eu-west-1) — current 5m error rate 12% (threshold 5%). Incident created: INC-2143

maria_eng: @alex_k can you share one full request/response (headers + auth token masked) and a request id? Need to confirm header rewrite at the gateway.

alex_k: paste - masked token

```
> POST /v1/generate
> Host: api.redwood.ai
> x-region-hint: eu-west-1
> authorization: Bearer ******

Response:
> 302 -> forwarded to gateway-proxy-003
> upstream-host: gateway-eu -> gateway-us-east
> status: 401
> x-upstream-region: us-east-1
```

alex_k: noticed that when gateway falls back (no healthy eu pool) it rewrites x-upstream-region to the fallback region but *doesn't* preserve x-region-hint, and Envoy strips or rewrites Authorization for the hop. Repro is quick with header set.

sre_jen: that matches a config regression we rolled 2 hours ago to change fallback routing priority. Possible bug in L7 route handoff where `preserve_host_header` and `preserve_authorization` are false for fallback clusters.

maria_eng: can you run this curl from an EU node? `curl -v -H "x-region-hint: eu-west-1" -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` — capture `-> upstream` lines.

alex_k: running from eu-testbox-7

```
* Connected to api.redwood.ai
> GET /v1/generate
> x-region-hint: eu-west-1
> Authorization: Bearer TEST
< HTTP/1.1 302 Found
< location: https://gateway-proxy.internal/
* Connected to gateway-proxy-003.us-east-1.internal
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< x-upstream-region: us-east-1
```

alex_k: repro done. So creds are valid in eu cluster but dropped when forwarded to us-east. Customer billing spike likely from failover traffic leaving eu egress and hitting us-east (double egress + inter-region bandwidth).

billing_team: confirm — we show ~1.2TB cross-region egress in last hour for that org, cost anomaly flagged. We need a mitigation ASAP to stop extra charges.

maria_eng: immediate mitigation options:
- revert the fallback routing change (hotfix) to restore per-region sticky routing
- force gateway to preserve `Authorization` and `x-region-hint` on fallback hops
- add temporary route rule to prefer returning 503 instead of failing over (so customer gets local errors instead of cross-region auth mismatch)

sre_jen: I can push a temporary env var to gateway service to disable the new fallback policy (flip ENABLE_REGION_FALLBACK=false) — roll to 3 instances now.

sre_jen: rolled to 3 instances, monitoring. :hammer_and_wrench:

oncall_bot: DEPLOYMENT: config update applied to gateway-proxy cluster (3/3).

alex_k: after rollback, auth errors dropped to baseline and upstream_region is now eu-west-1 on sampled requests. Customer confirms reduced latency and auth success. :thumbsup:

billing_team: good — halting anomaly alerting and starting to reconcile charges. We should request credit for ~1.2TB cross-region egress with finance if root cause is our failover bug.

maria_eng: next steps for eng:
- create a test that verifies Authorization and custom region hint headers are preserved through fallback handoffs
- revert the route priority change in staging with full canary and header-preserve tests
- open a postmortem and include billing impact estimate

alex_k: here's a minimal repro script saved to the incident ticket INC-2143, includes tcpdump and curl steps.

support_eli: customer update sent: "We identified a routing regression in our gateway and have deployed a rollback. We're investigating root cause and will share a postmortem and billing reconciliation."

maria_eng: assigning to eng-ml and eng-platform for deeper review. tagging @sre_jen for follow-up.

sre_jen: filing PR to add integration test and fix config defaults. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/4567 (WIP)

alex_k: thanks everyone. keeping incident open until postmortem and billing reconciliation complete.

support_eli: closing customer-facing loop after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
